svg.title: ShowAI information funnel — auto
svg.desc: Two circular arcs create a wide open top and meet tangentially at the bottom edge, closing the funnel. The left field is the brand RGB(18, 10, 143) lightened with 30 percent white, the right field is white, and the middle continuously transitions from white at the top to the same lightened blue at the bottom. This two-color palette works on both light and dark backgrounds.
